title: Simulation 3D Vehicle with Ground Following
text: 实现 3D 环境中跟随地面的车辆，输入 4 路、输出 2 路；按 {Color} 指定车辆颜色；{Type} 指定车辆类型 Muscle、{Path to custom mesh}、{Track width in custom mesh (m)} 指定轮距、{Wheel base in custom mesh (m)} 指定轴距、{Wheel radius in custom mesh (m)} 指定车轮半径、{Initial position [X, Y, Z] (m)} 指定初始车辆位置、{Initial rotation [Roll, Pitch, Yaw] (deg)} 指定车辆初始旋转角度、{Name} 指定车辆名称 SimulinkVehicle1、{Sample time} 指定采样时间、{Enable light controls} 控制车辆灯光、{Headlight color [R,G,B]} 指定前照灯颜色、{High beam intensity (cd)} 指定远光强度、{Low beam intensity (cd)} 指定近光强度、{High beam cone half angle (deg)} 指定远光锥半角、{Low beam cone half angle (deg)} 指定近光锥半角、{Left headlight beam orientation [Pitch, Yaw] (deg)} 指定左前照灯光束方向、{Right headlight beam orientation [Pitch, Yaw] (deg)} 指定右前照灯光束方向、{Brake light intensity (cd/m^2)} 指定强度、{Reverse light intensity (cd/m^2)} 指定强度、{Turn signal light intensity (cd/m^2)} 指定强度、{Period (s)} 指定转向信号灯周期、{Pulse width (% of period)} 指定脉冲宽度、{Output location (m) and orientation (rad)} 输出车辆的位置和方向，按实例取值。

ports.name: Yaw
ports.summary: 车辆的偏航方向角 scalar

params.name: Type
params.values: 车辆类型 Muscle car (default) | Sedan | Sport utility vehicle | Small pickup truck | Hatchback | Box truck | Custom

params.name: Path to custom mesh
params.values: Path to custom mesh /MathWorksSimulation/Vehicles/Muscle/Meshes/SK_MuscleCar.SK_MuscleCar (default) | valid path

params.name: Track width in custom mesh (m)
params.values: 轮距 1.9 (default) | scalar

params.name: Wheel base in custom mesh (m)
params.values: 轴距 3 (default) | scalar

params.name: Wheel radius in custom mesh (m)
params.values: 车轮半径 0.35 (default) | scalar

params.name: Color
params.values: 车辆颜色 Red (default) | Orange | Yellow | Green | Blue | Black | White | Silver

params.name: Initial position [X, Y, Z] (m)
params.values: 初始车辆位置 [0, 0, 0] (default) | real-valued 1-by-3 vector

params.name: Initial rotation [Roll, Pitch, Yaw] (deg)
params.values: 车辆初始旋转角度 [0, 0, 0] (default) | real-valued 1-by-3 vector

params.name: Name
params.values: 车辆名称 SimulinkVehicle1 (default) | vehicle name

params.name: Sample time
params.values: 采样时间 -1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Enable light controls
params.values: 控制车辆灯光 off (default) | on

params.name: Headlight color [R,G,B]
params.values: 前照灯颜色 [1,1,1] (default) | 1-by-3 array of RGB triplet values

params.name: High beam intensity (cd)
params.values: 远光强度 100000 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Low beam intensity (cd)
params.values: 近光强度 60000 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: High beam cone half angle (deg)
params.values: 远光锥半角 70 (default) | positive scalar less than or equal to 90

params.name: Low beam cone half angle (deg)
params.values: 近光锥半角 70 (default) | positive scalar less than or equal to 90

params.name: Left headlight beam orientation [Pitch, Yaw] (deg)
params.values: 左前照灯光束方向 [Pitch, Yaw] (deg) [0,0] (default) | 1-by-2 array with values between -180 and 180

params.name: Right headlight beam orientation [Pitch, Yaw] (deg)
params.values: 右前照灯光束方向 [0,0] (default) | 1-by-2 array with values between -180 and 180

params.name: Brake light intensity (cd/m^2)
params.values: 强度 500 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Reverse light intensity (cd/m^2)
params.values: 强度 500 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Turn signal light intensity (cd/m^2)
params.values: 强度 500 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Period (s)
params.values: 转向信号灯周期 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Pulse width (% of period)
params.values: 脉冲宽度 50 (default) | positive scalar less than 100

params.name: Output location (m) and orientation (rad)
params.values: 输出车辆的位置和方向 off (default) | on
